pages.text: $(bold)$(li)$(thing)Horses$(n) take shoes, a cart and an upgraded saddle: $(l:paths/rider)Rider$(n), $(l:paths/cartwright)Cartwright$(n), $(l:paths/tack)Tack$(n).$(br)$(li)$(thing)Trains$(n): ring 9. $(thing)Airships$(n): $(l:paths/aeronautics)Aeronautics$(n), ring 10.$(br2)Your legs start at 85% and reach 110% only at ring 14. A horse is worth having early.
pages.title: A7. Getting About
The Monoliths
pages.text: $(bold)Great stones stand across the world, each holding a $(thing)waystone$(n).$(br2)$(li)Right-click one to wake it.$(br)$(li)From any woken waystone, travel to the others you have woken.$(br2)They answer you from $(l:paths/explorer)Explorer$(n), ring 5.

pages.title: Your Own Waystones
pages.text: $(bold)$(li)$(l:paths/explorer)Explorer$(n), ring 5: use the Monoliths' waystones. You cannot move or break them.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/attunement)Attunement$(n), ring 11: craft and place your own, with warp stones and scrolls.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/warp_network)Warp Network$(n), ring 13: sharestones, portstones and warp plates.

pages.title: Immersive Aircraft
pages.text: $(bold)Two nodes on the Ranger road, after Boatwright:$(br2)$(li)$(l:paths/aviator)Aviator$(n), ring 6: the airship, gyrodyne, biplane and quadrocopter, and their parts.$(br)$(li)$(l:paths/air_fleet)Air Fleet$(n), ring 9: the cargo airship, the warship, better engines and the weapons.
